title: Holloman AFB landing footage that Allan Sandler saw
summary: James Fox tells of Holloman AFB landing footage that Allan Sandler saw, about 1964 at Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

No question about it. Three came in over the base. Two peeled away. One came down and landed.
tellings.difference: Fox states it with certainty ('No question about it') and says two craft peeled away while one landed.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the Holloman AFB landing footage (three craft come in, one lands), credited to Sandler, Shartle, Emenegger, Coleman and Lorenzen.

tellings.difference: Adds that the craft landed on the tarmac near a hangar and that a tall Nordic-looking NHI came down a gangway; dates it to April 1964 and gives no source.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the 1964 Holloman AFB landing: three craft come in over the base and one lands. Davis also describes a tall Nordic-looking being coming down a gangway.

as_told.title: Holloman AFB landing and tall Nordic NHI
as_told.place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

related.note: Both are James Fox telling of a UFO landing at Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico. This telling ties the landing to a claimed meeting with Eisenhower, while the story places it in 1964 and rests it on footage Allan Sandler saw. Those are competing accounts of when the landing happened and who was there, so either could be right.

plain: This story is about a film said to show flying saucers landing at Holloman Air Force Base, a US military base in New Mexico, in 1964. A UFO researcher named James Fox, speaking on the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, says that a man named Allan Sandler told him he had seen this footage. According to Fox, the film showed three saucers coming in over the base, two peeling away and one coming down to land. Sandler, as Fox tells it, said it might have been a training video but that the saucers in it were real, and Fox says of it, "No question about it." Fox ties the story to other people, including Robert Emenegger, Paul Shartle and a Colonel Coleman, to a documentary called UFOs Past, Present and Future, and to articles by a UFO writer named Coral Lorenzen. A second teller, a scientist named Eric Davis, tells it on the same podcast without naming a source and puts it in April 1964. He adds that the landing craft set down on the tarmac near a hangar, and that a walkway came down and a very tall humanoid being stepped out, a non-human intelligence who looked Northern European. If true, it would mean the US military met and filmed visitors from elsewhere openly on one of its own bases.
